subject: Rapid Response Playbook — Kaleidos go-live coverage request
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Rapid Response Playbook — Kaleidos go-live coverage request

Team — Kaleidos (launching trial next Wed) just asked if we can provide an elevated response SLA for the first 72 hours of their public beta. Key asks from them: P1 acknowledgement within 15 minutes and remediation starts within 1 hour, P2 acknowledgement within 1 hour. They want a named escalation contact and proactive status updates every 30 minutes for P1 incidents.

I discussed with the account team and they asked if we can:
- Temporarily augment on-call coverage for the 72-hour window starting 2025-09-03 00:00 UTC
- Provide a documented escalation path (SRE -> Eng on-call) with guaranteed callback within 30 minutes for any P1 that escalates beyond SRE triage
- Offer a service credit if we miss the agreed P1 response commitments more than twice during that window

Attachments: kaleidos_sla_request_v2.pdf (customer ask), oncall_rotation_proposal.xlsx (draft shift plan)

Can you review feasibility (cost, operational risk, routing) and propose a minimal change to our SLOs we can commit to for 72 hours? Also include what guardrails we should require (rate limits, fallback to reduced throughput, maximum # of escalations per hour).

Thanks — A.
Avery Johnson
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-30T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rapid Response Playbook — Kaleidos go-live coverage request

Avery — good catch. Quick thoughts:
- 15 minute acknowledgement is aggressive for our current tiered support model. We can offer a 30 minute P1 ack with 1 hour remediation start provided we put SRE escalation in the loop immediately on first triage.
- Operational plan: add two additional SRE shifts (overnight overlap) for the 72-hour window; rotate Marcus and two senior SREs from the dedicated pool. That covers the 24/7 requirement without altering long term SLAs.
- Escalation path: SRE -> Marcus Lin (engineering lead) -> Pager to on-call Eng (30 min callback guarantee). We need Marcus to sign off on the callback SLA.

Guardrails I recommend:
1) Soft cap: if we hit >5 P1s in any 6-hour block, we trigger automatic throttling to the customer's non-critical tier and inform them immediately.
2) No protocol changes that increase compute cost by >30% without finance approval (we can offer credits instead of unlimited scaling).
3) Limit number of guaranteed escalations per day to 6 (to prevent on-call saturation).

Costs: estimate additional SRE contractor hours ~120 hrs across 72 hours; I can put rough $ number once Marcus confirms the on-call load.

-Ben
From: Nicholas Grant <nicholas.grant@kaleidos.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@kaleidos.ai, support@kaleidos.ai
Date: 2025-08-30T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rapid Response Playbook — Kaleidos go-live coverage request

Avery / team — appreciate the quick turnaround on this. A few clarifications from our side:
- We can accept 30 minute ack for P1 if remediation starts within 1 hour and we have the engineering callback guarantee within 30 minutes of SRE escalation.
- During the 72 hour window we'll have two on-site ops engineers who can provide logs and reproduce hits quickly. We will also provide an ops slack channel for direct alerts.
- We need the escalation contact to be a named individual with a mobile pager or escalation phone number (not just a shared inbox).

We are open to a 2-week trial if that helps validate the process, but our legal team prefers a defined 72-hour production window for the launch. We can sign a short addendum for credits if the SLA is missed twice.

Nicholas Grant
Head of Platform Operations, Kaleidos AI
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-30T14:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rapid Response Playbook — Kaleidos go-live coverage request

Thanks all — I'll coordinate commercial terms with Finance. Proposal to move forward:
- Approve a temporary SLA document for 72 hours that specifies: 30m P1 ack, 1h remediation start, 1h P2 ack. Named escalation contact: Marcus Lin (mobile to be provided).
- Offer Kaleidos a 15% one-time credit against first-month usage if we miss P1 remediation start more than once during the 72-hour window. Credit to be capped at $25k.
- Implement Ben's guardrails. If Marcus confirms capacity, Ops should publish a brief runbook (30–60 minutes) outlining expected telemetry we will need.

Action items:
- Marcus: confirm you can be the named escalation lead and accept callback SLA. If yes, please confirm by EOD.
- Ben: finalize SRE shift list and expected hours (I need a cost estimate for Finance).
- Avery: I'll draft the 72-hour addendum and push to legal review.

Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-31T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rapid Response Playbook — Kaleidos go-live coverage request

Monica / team — I can take the named escalation lead role for the 72-hour window with these explicit constraints:
- Marcus will accept pager callbacks within 30 minutes for P1s that SRE escalates, provided SRE supplies the initial triage notes and a reproducible failure case or log excerpt. No callback SLA if the issue is data-sensitive and requires secure channel escalation (we'll handle via encrypted incident channel).
- Approve automatic fallback to the customer's non-critical tier when >=6 active incidents are open or >5 P1s in 6 hours.
- We need an ops Slack channel and a shared logging link for quick context — Kaleidos to provide on boarding by 09/02.

Ben: I approve the SRE shift plan contingent on you adding two senior SREs (names) and confirming the contractor coverage. Please share the final hours estimate so Finance can sign off.

Avery: once I have the runbook and the SRE names, I approve the 72-hour addendum. Let's keep the credit terms as Monica proposed.

Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager, Runtime Services
Redwood Inference
